## play.google.com (Platform; Japan)

- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix.ff7g_bike -- the Android row -- accessed 2026-10-20 (found by the user; the package id is not in the usual android_googleplay form)
  - Gone (404). The row links the capture of 2015-11-28, the last one that still shows the live game (version 2.0.0, updated 2015-11-26, 100,000 to 500,000 installs): https://web.archive.org/web/20151128160608/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix.ff7g_bike
  - Capture of 2015-03-16 (page text pasted by user): FINAL FANTASY VII G-BIKE, Square Enix, Action, version 1.2.0 of 2015-02-24, 4,592 ratings (3.2 stars), 100,000 to 500,000 installs, Android 2.3.3 or later, in-app purchases; the Gバイク minigame of Final Fantasy VII rebuilt as a new game, a bike chase with touch controls, missions with a roulette reward, materia, limit breaks, summons and bikes other than Hardy-Daytona; user reviews (October 2014 to March 2015) mostly complain of lag, crashes, stamina limits and gem prompts and ask for an English version
  - The last captures (2015-12-21 and 2016-02-08) show version 2.0.1 of 2015-12-14 with the note "サービス終了の対応を行いました" (end-of-service handling), so the service ended around December 2015; the Android row skips them
  - The capture of 2015-08-22 (page text pasted by user): version 1.7.0 of 2015-07-30, 4,824 ratings (3.2 stars), 100,000 to 500,000 installs, Everyone 10+, the same description; some reviews praise it on fast devices (a Nexus 9, an HTC M8) and say it stutters on slower ones
  - The capture of 2016-02-08 (page text pasted by user, Swedish layout): the same description, version 2.0.1 of 2015-12-14 ("サービス終了の対応を行いました"), 4,969 ratings (3.2 stars), 100,000 to 500,000 installs, PEGI 7, the final listing
